subject: Life Skills
title: The Trust Equation
description: A quick, practical guide to The Trust Equation.

hook.text: Charles Green created a trust equation: credibility plus reliability plus intimacy, divided by self-orientation.

buildup.text: Credibility means you know your stuff. Reliability means you do what you say. Intimacy means people feel safe with you.

discovery.text: Self-orientation is the denominator. The more you focus on yourself, the more it divides and shrinks all three above it.

twist.text: You can be credible and reliable but still not trusted. If people sense you are in it for yourself, the math collapses.

climax.text: Lower the denominator: listen more, share credit, and ask about their concerns before pitching your solution.

quiz.question: In the trust equation, what factor destroys trust the most?
